notes: Elapsed calendar time is not proven queue time or labour time. Pending is a recorded milestone, not proof of funding.
Unresolved applications are censored at the historical cutoff; resolution percentiles exclude them.
Repeated completed W_ records are an investigation proxy. Review the original case evidence before proposing an intervention.
Pilot scenarios use the original Conservative, Base and Stretch assumptions. Capacity value is hypothetical, not achieved savings; implementation cost is EUR 20,000.
Case investigation shows up to three deterministic examples per selection, using real ordered business activities with anonymized labels. It is not an exhaustive case browser.
validation: 31,509 applications, 1,202,267 events and 5,086 extra completions reconcile with source exports.
Full-population median and P90 match python_kpis.csv to 1e-8 calendar days.
Every displayed start-month/application-type cohort is calculated from the case fact; exact-path coverage is recalculated within that cohort.
